finding.comment: 'never rejects for size' is contradicted by the Uploads section's 100 MB rejection; the doc cannot decide the actual limit behavior.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/api-limits.md
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+# Request limits
+
+The API never rejects requests for size. Any payload is accepted.
+
+## Uploads
+
+Uploads larger than 100 MB are rejected with 413 by the upload
+endpoint.

rationale: genuine contradiction (any payload vs 100 MB cap)
